intro: Eswatini, formerly Swaziland, is one of the world's last absolute monarchies.

chapters.title: The Swazi kingdom
text: The Swazi kingdom formed in the 1700s and 1800s under kings like Sobhuza I and Mswati II, after whom the people are named.

chapters.title: British protection
text: Britain ruled Swaziland as a protectorate from 1903. It became independent in 1968.

chapters.title: Absolute monarchy
text: King Sobhuza II banned political parties in 1973. King Mswati III has reigned since 1986. In 2018 the country was renamed Eswatini. Pro-democracy protests in 2021 were met with force.
